questions.prompt: What does the CS in CSMA stand for? (two words)
Under CSMA, what does a node do if it senses the channel is busy?
options: Defers: waits until the channel is idle

questions.prompt: Why can collisions still happen with carrier sensing?
options: Propagation delay: a node may not hear another's just-started transmission yet
Carrier sensing only works on fiber

questions.prompt: With plain CSMA, a collision wastes the entire frame's transmission time.
What does CSMA/CD add to CSMA?
options: Listening while transmitting, and aborting as soon as a collision is detected

questions.prompt: Collision detection is just as easy on wireless links as on wired ones.
What does an Ethernet NIC send right after it aborts a collided frame?
After its 3rd collision in a row, an Ethernet NIC picks K from which set?
A NIC picks K = 5. How many bit times does it wait? (a number)
Ethernet's backoff unit is 512 bit times. How many bytes is 512 bits? (a number)

options: CSMA/CA, with an acknowledgment for every frame

questions.prompt: On a modern switched, full-duplex Ethernet network, CSMA/CD is rarely needed.
